Splunk Observability Cloud (splunk-observability) and Splunk Enterprise
(splunk-platform) are mandatory: copy those two entries from .mcp.optional.json
and supply the command your organisation runs. Do not guess a command.
Other servers are recommended or used only when already present. The
classification is skills/references/mcp-servers.md. Jira is not declared here;
intake uses a Jira MCP only when the host session already has one.
